description: JSON config loader and Elysia app bootstrap under /api/v1
spec:
1. Create config/habit-tracker.json with app, database, and server sections.
2. Implement a config loader in backend/src that reads the JSON config (no .env).
3. Bootstrap an Elysia app mounted under /api/v1 with pino logging.
4. Add a health route (GET /api/v1/health) returning ok status.
5. Confirm the backend starts and the database path resolves to data/habit-tracker.db.
6. Verify no database file is created outside data/ at project root.
title: Backend config loader and Elysia bootstrap
